name: Computer
description: Negotiated macOS desktop operations: targeted accessibility actions where supported and explicitly labeled, cancellable foreground takeover as the reliable baseline.
mainDocument: If available, start with computer_list_windows; its query filters windows only. Otherwise use the supplied exact window target. Prefer a returned exact window ref with computer_inspect; providers without discovery accept an explicit native window target. Inspect coverage and follow nextCursor alone to read the immutable captured controls beyond the first page; native traversal omissions remain explicit and are not recoverable by paging. References express exact-fingerprint presentation continuity, not proven native object identity. Actions use exact control refs and native revalidation. Pass since with a retained observation ref for a diff; omit since or set full:true after context compaction/lost context. For retained controls, pass the control ref with an explicit latest observation ref; native action checks still decide freshness. Cursor pages do not replace the first-page diff baseline or renew action authority. Discard prior continuation pages on every new observation or first-page diff and follow its new nextCursor for tails. Prefer background-safe semantic controls. Native macOS global input requires this thread's selected target. computer_select_target or computer_screenshot selects one exact window; it does not activate it. Input activates and checks that same window after approval. Click x/y are screenshot image pixels and require its captureId, not desktop coordinates. Key/scroll/type/shortcut require the bindingId returned by select/screenshot; reuse it without a screenshot per key, so pending approval cannot silently follow a later selection. After stale geometry, closed target, cancelled or uncertain input, reselect/reobserve; never replay an uncertain action automatically. A full desktop image never selects a target. Other providers do not inherit this binding guarantee. When AX is empty or partial, explicitly capture the same window then call computer_ocr with that captureId for local visual text. OCR boxes are not accessibility controls and do not authorize semantic press. OCR never activates, wakes or unlocks the desktop. Screenshot captureSource/backgroundInputEligible distinguish verified native window input proof from legacy read-only images. Older macOS and known oversized SCK images retain active-only legacy screenshots/OCR, which never authorize background click.

permissions.title: Inspect a targeted app
permissions.description: Read a bounded accessibility tree for an explicitly targeted app or window.

permissions.title: Act on a targeted control
permissions.description: Perform a semantic press or set a semantic value on an explicitly selected accessibility control without global input.

permissions.title: Capture a targeted window
permissions.description: Capture one explicitly targeted app window to a private short-lived artifact.

permissions.title: Control the foreground desktop
permissions.description: Use global pointer, keyboard, focus, or scrolling. ZenX exposes these as explicitly labeled, cancellable foreground takeover.

permissions.title: Click inside a background window
permissions.description: Send one left click to an exact captured window without desktop foreground or pointer takeover; application-internal focus may change.

tools.name: computer_background_click
tools.description: Left-click x/y image pixels of this thread's current exact-window screenshot without desktop activation, raising or pointer movement. Native macOS 14+ console session, including locked; requires a fresh verified native full-window screenshot (SCK when bright, WindowServer when asleep) and uses a runtime-checked window-local primitive and separate permission. Consumes the capture. Application-internal focus may change. Posted/release receipts do not verify application effect; never retry unknown input automatically.

tools.name: computer_environment
tools.description: Read the current desktop session and power availability. lockedTools names this provider’s scoped capabilities while locked; re-inspect for fresh controls and treat native failures as failures. Only explicitly listed native scoped tools may work while locked; foreground input requires an active session. This read does not wake, unlock, or operate another app.

tools.name: computer_list_windows
tools.description: List up to 32 open desktop windows and their running applications without activating them. Pass a case-insensitive query matching application name, PID, or title to narrow truncated results. Use its returned window ref with computer_inspect; this is not a catalog of installed apps.

tools.name: computer_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a bounded first page of at most 32 controls in one exact app window, or follow nextCursor without recapture. Coverage separately reports available pages and native omissions; this is not a complete accessibility tree. Model callers use since with an exact observation ref to request a diff; omit it or set full:true to resync. target.windowTitle is required.

cursor.description: Continue the exact immutable captured observation using its returned nextCursor. Does not recapture or renew action references. Omit to inspect afresh.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: computer_press
tools.description: Perform a native semantic press on one control returned by computer_inspect. Does not move the pointer, type keys, or activate the target app.

tools.name: computer_set_value
tools.description: Set the supplied text on one editable opaque target from the latest computer_inspect observation. The value follows the ordinary tool path and host/model policy decides how it is handled.

tools.name: computer_screenshot
tools.description: Capture one explicit app/window target to a private five-minute PNG artifact. Returns metadata/path, never pixels in the Thread journal.

tools.name: computer_foreground_click
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: click image-pixel x/y in this thread's selected exact window. Requires current window screenshot captureId; validates window/focus immediately before native posting.

tools.name: computer_foreground_key_press
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: press one allowlisted key in the focused control. Stop cancels the running operation.

tools.name: computer_foreground_scroll
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: scroll the current foreground target. Stop cancels the running operation.

tools.name: computer_foreground_type
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: type up to 1024 Unicode scalars into this thread's selected exact window using Unicode keyboard events, without clipboard access. Does not guarantee application acceptance. Partial/cancelled input must not be replayed automatically; no text is echoed in the receipt.

tools.name: computer_foreground_shortcut
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: send one shortcut to this thread's selected exact window. key is a logical unshifted letter/digit in the current Command layout when command is present, otherwise the current base layout; modifiers apply separately. Navigation keys are layout-independent. Missing or ambiguous character mappings/input-source changes fail closed; no ANSI fallback.

tools.name: computer_ocr
tools.description: Read local visual text from this thread's current exact-window screenshot, with original capture time and top-left image-pixel boxes. Explicit ten-second read, not an automatic AX fallback. Up to 96 text boxes/16 KiB text; accepts an original image at most 16 MP and locally bounds recognition to 4 MP. Default languages zh-Hans then en-US; Chinese/English requests are normalized Chinese-first; returned languages report the effective order. Unsupported languages/combinations fail explicitly. Observations only, never AX controls or proof a click works. No recapture, foreground activation, wake, unlock or cloud OCR.

tools.name: computer_select_target
tools.description: Select this thread's exact application/window for subsequent foreground input without activating it. Supply an exact listed window target; application-only targets must resolve to exactly one window.
